concepts.proposed_markdown: Bearer-authenticated `POST /v1/contracts/updateEndDate` adds, changes, or removes a contract's exclusive end timestamp. Ending early impacts draft usage statements, truncates terms, and removes upcoming scheduled invoices; moving the date later extends only contract length, not terms, scheduled invoices, or in-advance subscriptions. Optional `allow_ending_before_finalized_invoice` defaults to `true`: finalized invoices remain unchanged when the new end precedes their end timestamps, and Metronome says callers can void and regenerate finalized usage invoices to incorporate the new end date. [[source-metronome-api-reference-contracts-update-the-contract-end-date]]
warnings: Keep this targeted v1 operation distinct from the broader v2 contract-edit surface and permanent contract archival.

- [[source-metronome-api-reference-contracts-update-the-contract-end-date]] - contract end-date mutation and the explicit boundary that a later end does not extend in-advance subscriptions
